sub_sector.value: nonperforming loan portfolio purchasing and collection; class action claim recovery

financial_business_type.detail: Buys and collects nonperforming loan portfolios; also securities and antitrust claim recovery services.

revenue_driver.detail: Earns on collections from purchased nonperforming loan portfolios; fee-based recovery services are smaller.

customer_type.detail: Buys from banks and credit issuers; collects from consumer debtors; serves institutional investors with recovery services.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Purchases loan portfolios with its own capital and bears collection risk.
